cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: I Know the Procedure
cards.instruction: Perform investigative confidence while quietly using each response to discover what the questions, clues, and next steps should be.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Naturally. The usual arrangement. I'll investigate the missing raffle tin. Naturally, we begin with access.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The cleaner has the only cupboard key.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly how we always do it. As expected. Where does our keyholder go after cleaning?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Reception. But the tin never went in the cupboard.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Good, we've eliminated that location. Confirm where you last saw it; I'll establish our next search area.

confusable: D138 feigns investigative know-how; S04 specifically adds imitation of a misunderstood cue.
comparison: Lost tin search versus door repair.
seedUse: Keep location elimination learned from B rather than invented omniscience.
